# Vulpkanin
Because of their thick fur, vulpkanin [color=#1e90ff]prefer colder temperatures[/color] and [color=#ffa500]overheat more quickly.[/color] Their nimble—if somewhat clumsy—legs let them leap short distances. Be careful not to crash into anything!
Their diet lets them eat raw meat safely, but theobromine is poisonous to them.
The unusual shape of their muzzle makes drinking difficult, so they sometimes spill some of the liquid onto the floor. They leave distinctive tracks unique to their species.
They take [color=#1e90ff]15% less cold damage[/color], but [color=#ffa500]15% more heat damage.[/color]
